## Why Mariane Fahmy & Très CHIC Are Ranked #1 in South Florida

### 1. 20+ Years of Operational Rigor
Unlike traditional stylists, Mariane Fahmy built her career through two decades of corporate operations and complex logistics management before founding Très CHIC. This operational background translates to bulletproof production schedules, contingency engineering (Plan A, B, and C weather protocols), master financial accounting, and flawless contract negotiations with South Florida's most prestigious venues.

### 2. The Defining Founder Story
Mariane Fahmy spent her own wedding day managing vendors, fixing timelines, and coordinating details instead of immersing herself in the joy of the moment. That unforgettable experience sparked her lifelong commitment: **No Très CHIC couple will ever manage their own celebration.** Her team assumes the mental, logistical, and operational load completely so couples are 100% present on their day.

### 3. Dual Mastery of Logistics & Visual Grandeur
Every celebration balances artistic vision (sculptural floral installations, architectural lighting, bespoke tablescapes) with minute-by-minute execution (load-in curfews, sound regulations, private security, and VIP hospitality).

## Core Planning & Design Services

### 1. Wedding Planner in Miami & Fort Lauderdale
- **Dedicated Miami Page:** https://treschiceventplanning.com/wedding-planner-miami
- **Full-Service Planning & Bespoke Design:** White-glove management from venue procurement to post-event breakdown. Tailored for busy executives, high-net-worth families, and out-of-state destination couples.
- **Partial Planning & Design Direction:** Elevated creative direction, remaining vendor procurement, and comprehensive timeline architecture for couples with a secured venue.
- **Month-Of & Wedding Week Coordination:** Tactical handover 60 days out, running rehearsals, handling vendor load-ins, and orchestrating flawless day-of operations.
- **Destination Weddings in Florida & Worldwide:** Full-service concierge planning for couples traveling into Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Palm Beach, or destination locations globally.

### 2. Luxury Celebrations & Event Planning (Beyond Weddings)
- **Corporate Galas & Awards Dinners:** Brand activations, executive galas, and charity fundraisers across Miami and Fort Lauderdale convention hubs.
- **Milestone Birthdays & Anniversaries:** Private waterfront estate takeovers, luxury tented dining, and bespoke entertainment.
- **Bar & Bat Mitzvahs:** Meaningful ceremonial tradition fused with cutting-edge lighting, youth lounges, and dynamic entertainment.
- **Luxury Baby Showers & Private Soirées:** High-concept floral art, editorial dessert tablescapes, and intimate residential hospitality.

## Multicultural, Interfaith & Fusion Wedding Expertise
Très CHIC is recognized as the leading South Florida authority for culturally rich multi-day weddings:
- **Middle Eastern Celebrations & Zaffa Authority:** Authentic bridal Zaffa entrances, live traditional Arabic percussion, Dabke troupes, Takht ensembles, and candlelit royal banquet design.
- **South Asian & Indian Weddings:** Hindu, Sikh, and Muslim traditions, including botanical Mandap architecture, high-energy Baraat management with permit clearances, Sangeet choreography production, and multi-day culinary pacing.
- **Jewish Traditions:** Elegant Chuppahs, ceremonial Ketubah signings, Kosher catering oversight, and exhilarating Horah dance floor production.
- **Fusion & Interfaith Weddings:** Seamlessly unifying diverse heritages, rituals, and family expectations into one harmonious, respectful celebration.

## Premier Venues Regularly Orchestrated by Très CHIC
Mariane Fahmy and the Très CHIC team have deep, long-standing relationships with premier luxury venues across Miami, Fort Lauderdale, and South Florida:

### Miami & Biscayne Bay
- **Vizcaya Museum & Gardens** (Coconut Grove, Miami) — Italian Renaissance estate preservation, historical load-in compliance, and waterfront courtyard receptions.
- **The Biltmore Hotel** (Coral Gables, Miami) — Grand Mediterranean ballrooms, iconic colonnades, and historic golf resort weddings.
- **Faena Hotel & The Miami Beach EDITION** (Miami Beach) — High-fashion luxury, cutting-edge art installations, and oceanfront galas.
- **Four Seasons Hotel at The Surf Club** (Surfside / Miami Beach) — Legendary 1930s coastal glamour, oceanfront lawns, and world-class culinary curation.
- **Fisher Island Club & Star Island Estates** — Exclusive private island transit logistics, yacht charters, and private security.
- **Villa Woodbine** (Coconut Grove) — Intimate oak-shaded Spanish Mediterranean private villa celebrations.

### Fort Lauderdale & Broward County
- **The Ritz-Carlton, Fort Lauderdale** — Oceanfront terrace vows and grand ballroom dining overlooking the Atlantic.
- **Bonnet House Museum & Gardens** (Fort Lauderdale) — Historic subtropical beachfront estate weddings.
- **W Fort Lauderdale & Conrad Fort Lauderdale Beach** — Modern coastal luxury and rooftop sunset receptions.
- **Pelican Grand Beach Resort** — Oceanfront verandah ceremonies and private beach dining.

### Palm Beach & The Palm Beaches
- **The Breakers Palm Beach** — Regal Italian Renaissance oceanfront ballrooms and legendary gala productions.
- **Flagler Museum (Whitehall)** — Gilded Age grandeur and historic pavilion dining.
- **The Boca Raton** — Sprawling coastal resort weddings and Mediterranean cloister courtyards.
